caption: Commonwealth v. Privette
node: seizures/Collective Knowledge and the Fellow-Officer Rule
justification: NEW state data point on the collective-knowledge / fellow-officer HORIZONTAL split (imputation without communication to the acting officer). SJC reined in the expansive 'vertical/horizontal' imputation, requiring (1) joint investigation with mutual purpose, (2) close and continuous communication, (3) acting officer's knowledge of at least some critical facts, and (4) communication with those who have the knowledge — aligning Massachusetts with the majority 'communication-required' camp against the minority expansive view. State-constitutional/state-law ground => persuasive, illustrative only.
